newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stockpile sells ferro-chrome and vanadium.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stockpile sells ferro-chrome and vanadium.

text.p: The U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center sold approximately 7,000 short tons of high carbon ferro-chrome to Macalloy Corp of North Charleston, SC.
The approximate current market value is $4 million, the Center said.
The stockpile also announced that it sold vanadium pentoxide to Aimcor of Pittsburgh.
Aimcor bought 67,839 pounds for $211,657, equivalent to a unit price of $3.12 per pound. Bids for the next vanadium sale are due by 10 am, Oct 24.
